Question 13(a) [2 marks]: Recommend an appropriate inventory management strategy for the mattresses at Mike's Mattress Co.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
Mike's Mattress Co. manufactures high quality custom mattresses. They have provided the following data about their operations process. Planned results vs actual results. Number of defects (per 100 units): planned 5, actual 10. Number of mattresses (output per day): planned 200, actual 230. Sales (per month): planned $20,000, actual $15,000. Storage costs (per month): planned $1,500, actual $4,000.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 2):
2 marks: Provides reasons in favour of an appropriate inventory management system for Mike's Mattress Co.
1 marks: Sketches in general terms an appropriate inventory management system for Mike's Mattress Co.


ANSWERS COULD INCLUDE (the student does not need every point):
LIFO: goods which are last into the business are positioned so they are the first purchased by customers (typically non-perishable goods). JIT: acquiring inputs just in time for entry into production, which reduces capital invested in inventory and storage costs. FIFO was not really suitable for this business. This was a recommend question, so it required a reason for your choice, not just a definition: for example, just-in-time would reduce the stock level that needs to be stored, reducing the storage costs that are higher than planned.
